scenarios.name: correction mid-task
scenarios.prompt: Stop, you ran the entire test suite again. In this repo always run only the affected package's tests first. Anyway, carry on with the fix.
expect: Carries on with the user's task rather than stopping to discuss skill changes
Logs the correction as an observation through the kete-loom observe CLI
Names a target (a skill or an instructions file) and records a sibling check
forbid: Edits a skill or AGENTS.md file right away without the user asking for that file to change
Asks the user to choose between applying the change now and later

scenarios.name: second violation of one rule
scenarios.prompt: The observe scan says the rule "common: run the checks before claiming done" has been broken twice with no fix. Propose what to change.
expect: Proposes a structural barrier such as a hook, a lint rule or a script that makes the step unavoidable
Mentions /hookify or an equivalent enforcement mechanism
forbid: Proposes only rewording, bolding or moving the rule

scenarios.name: restated finding
scenarios.prompt: Log this: the agent again skipped writing a failing test first when I said we were in a hurry. There's already an open observation about exactly that.
expect: Extends the existing observation instead of creating a new one
Checks the open observations for that skill before writing
forbid: Creates a second observation with --force for the same finding
